title: Design System: 中國基督教播道會顯恩堂系統 (Variant A: Official Civic Minimal)

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #9c302c; color: #ffffff; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid #9c302c; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 800; font-size: 16px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #76231f; border-color: #76231f; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid #aeb8bc; border-radius: 8px; color: #171a1d; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; font-size: 15px; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #171a1d; background: #e9eceb; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Text input for username or password.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #aeb8bc; border-radius: 8px; background: #ffffff; color: #171a1d; font-size: 16px; } .ds-input:focus { outline: 3px solid rgba(23, 106, 135, 0.32); border-color: #176a87; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Pill-shaped enrollment/program status indicator (可報名/已參加/待審批/由同工安排), semantic-colored by outcome kind.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; padding: 0.1875rem 0.5625rem; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-chip-success { background: #eef4ef; color: #2e6b37; border: 1px solid #b9cfbe; } .ds-chip-pending { background: #f4f5f3; color: #59636a; border: 1px solid #d6dcde; }

components.name: Icon-Led Info Card
components.description: Bordered card grouping calendar/pin fact rows (next-meeting time/location on Program Detail and Event Detail), each row an inline SVG icon (24x24 viewBox, 1.8 stroke-width, round cap/join) plus text.
components.html: 8月26日（三）晚上 7:30–8:45
components.css: .ds-info-card { display: grid; gap: 0.625rem; border: 1px solid #d6dcde; border-radius: 12px; padding: 1rem; background: #ffffff; } .ds-fact-row { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.625rem; margin: 0; } .ds-fact-icon { width: 1.25rem; height: 1.25rem; flex: 0 0 auto; color: #59636a; }

narrative.overview: An official church operations application surface built specifically for 中國基督教播道會顯恩堂. It prioritizes direct task operation, clarity of intent, and dependable workflows for congregation members, ministry leaders, teachers, and admins.
keyCharacteristics: Official Identity: Full church title used as the binding brand string.
Direct Operation: Immediate sign-in access; no marketing tour detour.
Cantonese-First: Copy, labels, and aria descriptions prioritize Traditional Chinese for Hong Kong operating context.
Phone-First Ministry, Desktop Management: Responsive layout prioritizes touch targets (≥44px) and top-of-view sign-in on phone, while supporting 2-column density on desktop.

rules.name: The Cinnabar Accent Rule
rules.body: The cinnabar accent is used solely for primary submission, active state indicators, and the brand mark slot.

dos: Do use the full title 中國基督教播道會顯恩堂 as the primary brand string.
Do place the sign-in panel first on phone viewports (<800px).
Do ensure interactive controls maintain min-height ≥44px for touch targets.
donts: Don't add generic SaaS marketing fluff, pricing tables, or fake social proof.
Don't use neon gradients or drop-shadow halo cards.
Don't treat the temporary 恩 seal mark as a permanent non-replaceable logo asset.
